operatorOutcome: The dirty-path count the LandOS checkpoint reports to a fresh agent is the real number of uncommitted files, so a directory of new work is never presented as a single path.
builderBrief:
Fix a real defect in this repository's durable-memory tooling.

`gitDirtyCount` in `scripts/memory/landos-memory.mjs` counts the lines of `git status --short`. That command collapses a wholly untracked directory into a single `?? dir/` entry, however many files are inside it. The count therefore understates how much uncommitted work is in the tree.

This number is not cosmetic. `refreshCheckpoint` puts it into `.landos/CHECKPOINT.md` as the line that tells a fresh coding agent how much of Tyler's work in progress it must preserve. In the live LandOS worktree the current reading is 254 when the true number of uncommitted files is 391, a 35 percent understatement.

Make `gitDirtyCount` count uncommitted files rather than status lines, at any depth, while keeping everything else about it the same: it still takes a repository root, still returns `null` when the path is not a git repository, and still returns a plain number otherwise. Change nothing else in the module; its other exports and their behaviour must be untouched. Change no other file.

No third-party dependencies are available in this working directory, and none are needed.

checks.next: Count uncommitted files rather than `git status --short` lines in gitDirtyCount: a wholly untracked directory must contribute one count per file inside it, at any depth, and a non-repository path must still return null.
